tool.name: SRR to BioSample
tool.description: Retrieve BioSample metadata from SRR accessions. Traverses NCBI Entrez from SRA to BioSample.

param.name: input1
param.label: SRR Accessions File
param.help: Text file with one SRR accession per line

tool.help:
Retrieve BioSample metadata from a list of SRR accessions. For each SRR accession in the input file, the tool:
1. Queries NCBI SRA database to find the SRA UID 2. Links from SRA to BioSample using Entrez elink 3. Retrieves BioSample metadata including organism, taxonomic ID, sample attributes, and package type 4. Outputs a tabular file with SRR accession as the first column, followed by all BioSample metadata fields
**Input:** Text file with one SRR accession per line (e.g., output from Bioproject to SRR tool)
**Output:** Tabular file with BioSample metadata. Each row corresponds to one input SRR accession.
**Note:** If a BioSample cannot be found for an SRR accession, the row will contain "NOT_FOUND" in the biosample_accession column.
